entries.provenance: ShortFuse's community-modified universal DLSS NR 310.8 runtime (string version 310.8.SF.0, numeric 310.8.2.0) from RankFTW/rhi-repo release dlssnr-310.8.SF-v2, GitHub verified archive digest 1da35941894994eb087e017577829e492454e9bae3a6a9397027069ceb74955c. The modification removes the embedded NVIDIA signature and extends the leaked 310.8.0 runtime to Turing, Ampere, Ada and Blackwell; the previous lock was the RTX 40-targeted dlssnr-310.8.0-RTX40 build.

NVIDIA-signed DLSS SR 310.9.1 runtime from the RankFTW/rhi-repo release dlss-310.9.1, fetched by tools/fetch_neural_runtime.ps1 and verified against archive digest aaba83b288bd145c3808e8d7a0ba03cc8c8676d18ad984b1bfa6563046a3ba37 before extraction and against the per-file digest above after staging. Replaces 310.8.0 (file C85F971C...). This is the module RenoDX detours to observe the player's DLSS/DLAA create before it builds feature 18, so it is the one runtime here whose version a neural render can actually feel; Streamline is deliberately NOT moved with it - see THIRD_PARTY.md.

ReShade 6.8.0 with add-on support, proxy DLL taken from ReShade_Setup_6.8.0_Addon.exe, fetched by tools/fetch_neural_runtime.ps1 and verified against installer digest afe4c8f13048306307983b8b3d41d5bf00a86820440b0e57dea10950e1176445 before extraction and against the per-file digest above after staging.

RenoDX DLSS 5 add-on 6.5.3 from the RankFTW/rhi-repo release renodx-dlss5-6.5.3; GitHub verified archive digest 553b1619b9e5ddfbcb4ebc7f2f3bffff9256a48a25b988f4817f5c63f4caa1de. Replaces 4.70 (archive d6e356d0..., file D5ADF82E...), whose [RenoDX.DLSS5] contract this player was written against: 6.x renames the upscaling control, drops the startup architecture banners the render evidence was proved from, and adds multi-pass stacking and an explicit HDR colour bridge.
